name: discipline-pack
description: Guardrails for agentic coding: gated workflow commands (orient / arch-check / implement / tdd-implement / orchestrate / stuck), operational commands (release / bump-dependency / cleanup), diagnostic and measurement commands (debug-incident / eval-skill) and enforcement hooks (protected branches, definition-of-done gate, format feedback, secret guard, dependency-vulnerability guard, KB-first nudge, session envelope).
